1.consolidated_definition: Conocer bien (o no) el asunto que se trae entre manos, o el parecer de las personas con las que se trata. “Me disgusta ir a esa reunión sin saber dónde estoy parada con la Junta.”
1.en_consolidated_definition: To be well or poorly informed about the matter at hand, or to have a clear understanding of the opinions of those with whom one is dealing. "I dislike attending that meeting without knowing where I stand with the Board."
